assumptions: Existing nodes are matched by explicit child name under parent and must retain the declared constructor type.

description: Idempotently reconcile a declarative Houdini network, optionally guard a prior Ensure Plan with expected_plan_hash, then Cook inside the same rollback boundary.
heuristics: Use this recipe for installer/reconciliation style graph edits that should be safe to run repeatedly.
Use expected-hash parm/connection operations instead when a write must remain conditional on an earlier external read.
When a separate network.ensure_plan was used for review/preflight, pass its plan_hash as expected_plan_hash to guard the Plan -> Ensure handoff.
